scope: Owned physical lease mutation completion, preserving public observer deadlines and immutable token fences
controls: Five successful held-reply cases and four canceled observers retain the real command permit and per-lease pending counter for more than 2.2 seconds.
LeaseSettlement remains unsettled until the actual Redis reply or disconnect; it does not report mutation success or exclude future operations.
A second command cannot acquire the sole occupied command slot.
Four lost replies execute the selected mutation once, with no replay.
Actual profile, credential, owner and unique-ledger effects settle and clean up.
Existing canceled ACQUIRE delivery retains its distinct fenced physical cleanup semantics.
not_changed: Public logical observer deadlines and sticky lost behavior
